plan.preprocessing: Fashion: existing full official TRAIN-only PCA64. HAR: train-only feature standardization. Same preprocessing for both arms.
plan.selection: fixed maximum TRAIN validation k15 overlap then trustworthiness; no official TEST reselection
plan.evaluation: 256 fixed TEST queries against full TRAIN+TEST population, k15; three fixed64point TEST PH subclouds raw/aligned H0/H1 including unmatched bars; frozen 15NN probe on all TEST; KMeans trained TRAIN then predicted TEST ARI/NMI with fixed known class count
plan.labels: only post-fit evaluation; no labels passed to reducer or model selection
plan.budgets: all declared steps; no early stopping; sampled negative counts and runtime differ
plan.calibration: Both arms use analytic TRAIN-pair least-squares scalar after fitting; no TEST scale fitting. Does not improve neighbor ranking or clustering. Report uncalibrated PH beside actual calibrated output; no structural-topology gain inferred from units alone.
plan.local_artifacts: compact model and all train/test embeddings in ignored outputs only
plan.limitations: Previously used benchmarks, not fresh external validation. Full population topology not claimed; report all topology regressions. HAR is direct transfer, not a new search.

population_geometry.scope: query rows versus all supplied population rows; self excluded; stable sample-ID ties

output_calibration.sampling: independent uniform pairs with replacement, including self-pairs
output_calibration.stress_convention: sqrt(sum squared distance errors / sum squared source distances)
output_calibration.scope: post-optimization scale only; histories/subset diagnostics are pre-calibration; no topology-shape improvement claimed

coverage.definition: unique sample IDs present in active loss subsets; not proof of nonzero per-sample gradients; steps are not epochs
